content.tex: Section A
INVESTIGATION THE VERTEX OF THE QUADRATIC FUNCTION
You are advised to spend no more than 45 minutes on this section.
In this task, you will investigate the change in the vertex of the quadratic function \(y = ax^{2} +bx+c\) as a or \(b\) changes.

parts.text: In this question, the value of a changes. The value of b and the value of c stay the same.
